djzc.dialog.wiki.title: Dong's MC Warfare Encyclopedia
djzc.dialog.wiki_notice.body2: This is an attack-and-defense battle set in a world of ice and snow. Whether you're a fresh recruit or a veteran returning after a long time away, the key info below will help you settle into the battlefield.
djzc.dialog.wiki.before_play.title: Read Before Playing
djzc.dialog.wiki.before_play.body1: Friendly tip: most user interactions in Dong's MC Warfare are based on the dialog system. If dialogs get cut off, adjust your video settings so the GUI fits within your screen
djzc.dialog.wiki.before_play.body4: · If you're on the attacking side (team T), capture all four sectors (A, B, C, D) to win.
djzc.dialog.wiki.before_play.body5: · If you're on the defending side (team CT), stop team T from capturing all sectors and hold out until time runs out to win.
djzc.dialog.wiki.before_play.body6: · Sectors A and B are contestable from the start; C and D must first have their activators activated before they can be captured.
djzc.dialog.wiki.before_play.body8: · Friendly fire is disabled in Dong's MC Warfare.
djzc.dialog.wiki.before_play.body9: · Enemy players' names are not shown above their heads; identify them by appearance (watch the colors of their armor trims)
djzc.dialog.wiki.before_play.body11: · %3$s: use %1$s or %2$s to open the %4$s and send radio commands (like 'Attack point A!' or 'Enemy spotted!'). If voice chat isn't available, this is the best fallback.
djzc.dialog.wiki.before_play.body12: · Bombardment: 'Bombardment Observation Towers' are hidden around the map. Use %1$s on a %2$s to bombard the designated area — it might hit you too, so be careful.
djzc.dialog.wiki.before_play.body13: · Point C activators: after capturing both A and B, the Point C activators will be highlighted; all of them must be activated to open Point C.
djzc.dialog.wiki.before_play.body14: · Point D activators: after capturing Point C, the Point D activators will be highlighted; all of them must be activated to open Point D.
djzc.dialog.wiki.before_play.body15: · Missile system: missiles can be decoyed by %1$s, and have proximity fuzes (they detonate within 3 meters of an enemy).
djzc.dialog.wiki.before_play.body16: · Class selection restrictions: the two aviation classes currently in the game each have some restrictions. See the 'Class Introduction' section for details
djzc.dialog.wiki.before_play.body17: · ——> Scoreboard: during a match, this shows players' kill counts; when no match is running, it shows players' readiness

djzc.dialog.wiki.how_to_play.title: How to Play
djzc.dialog.wiki.how_to_play.body2: · %1$s the %3$s (or press %2$s to open the GUI) to choose your team and class
djzc.dialog.wiki.how_to_play.body3: · Click 'Ready Up' to enter the ready state. When all players are ready, the game begins
djzc.dialog.wiki.how_to_play.body5: · There are four main categories (Assault, Recon, Support, Aviation), each with two subtypes — 8 selectable classes in total. See the 'Class Introduction' section for details
djzc.dialog.wiki.how_to_play.body7: · After choosing your class, head to the front line via the teleport system (also in the Member's Handbook). Teleport destinations include sectors, activators, spawn points, and your teammates' locations.
djzc.dialog.wiki.type_intro.title: Class Introduction
djzc.dialog.wiki.type_intro.body1: · There are four main class categories, each with two subtypes — 8 selectable classes in total
djzc.wiki_bzb_1: Banzai Soldier: A reminder to everyone — this is not very spirited
djzc.wiki_bzb_2: Design motivation: twisted humor. Historical prototype: the special attack units. Code legacy: it fed the %1$s, fed the %2$s next to Gungnir, and feeds half of Dong's MC Warfare's explosion effects.
djzc.wiki_bzb_3: ——And, as a reminder to everyone, this is not very spirited.
djzc.wiki_bzb_4: You know this thing is unbalanced. You know the Banzai Soldier can only be used once per match. You know that even if it isn't shot down, it will self-destruct after flying long enough. You made it anyway. Because Dong's MC Warfare is about more than winning or losing — so says DeepSeek.
djzc.wiki_fkb_1: Standard Soldier: the first to get kicked around, who later held up the whole sky
djzc.wiki_fkb_2: One of the Big Three. Designed personally by CE. The original Standard Soldier, armed with the 'Triple Tap', tickled melee soldiers like a feather before being kicked to death. — What is this? It's Dong's MC Warfare's earliest joke, and its most solid prophecy.
djzc.wiki_fkb_3: He took the worst beatings and waited the longest for a buff. From 1.0.1 all the way to 1.0.4, from 'can't pierce anything' to the %1$s joining the arsenal, from being farmed like an XP pack by melee soldiers to washing out any unit that dares fly low with an overwhelming rain of arrows.
djzc.wiki_fkb_4: The Standard Soldier was never 'standard'. He is Dong's MC Warfare's the team's eternal understudy and its latest-blooming protagonist. He tells every newcomer: in this game, no class is doomed to be useless, and no line of code is doomed to be an infinite loop. We once considered giving him a more fitting name — and we did. He waited two years for that name.
djzc.wiki_ggne_1: Operator · Gungnir: a glass cannon, and a way to punish people with poor static vision
djzc.wiki_ggne_2: Prototype designed by Remilia. The finished product assembled by CE.
djzc.wiki_ggne_3: Zero armor. One-shot kills. A dash attack. A glass cannon — and it punishes everyone with poor static vision. I've read this sentence three times. You're not writing a class introduction. You're writing about yourselves.
djzc.wiki_ggne_4: Who is the person with poor static vision? The enemy standing at a sniper spot thinking they're safe? Or the self pulling an all-nighter debugging, unable to find that one missing slash? Gungnir is not a weapon. Gungnir is the stubbornness of 'I can go one more round'.
djzc.wiki_jjs_1: Sniper: from being kicked to death, to sweeping through a thousand soldiers, to an emergency nerf
djzc.wiki_jjs_2: This is Dong's MC Warfare's own story too. At first, kicked to death by melee soldiers — later, taking up the sniper and its dedicated ammo, sweeping through a thousand soldiers — and later still, the emergency nerf.
djzc.wiki_jjs_3: Isn't that just like the fate of Dong's MC Warfare? Back in 1.0, who would have thought this game would survive to 1.0.6? Back in 1.0.1, who would have thought the idea of 'why don't we improve Dong's MC Warfare' would grow into what it is now? Back in 1.0.5, who would have thought we'd tear down nearly all the command blocks ourselves and slim the world save from 3.89 GB to 60 MB?
djzc.wiki_jjs_4: The Sniper was once strong, and got nerfed. Dong's MC Warfare once lagged, and got fixed. Warm and cold intertwined — that's what it means to be alive.
djzc.wiki_jzb_1: Melee Soldier: everyone wants him dead, and he's never gone down
djzc.wiki_jzb_2: Shield. Axe. Sword. Netherite armor. The most traditional, and the most solid.
djzc.wiki_jzb_3: How many times have we nerfed him? His protection was nerfed, his damage was nerfed, the map even cut down indoor areas to counter him — and still he holds up his shield and walks toward the point, step by step.
djzc.wiki_jzb_4: He is like the foundation of Dong's MC Warfare. We can build the Sniper's tall tower on it, lay the Aviator's runway on it, dig the snowfield village's underground tunnels under it — but a foundation is a foundation. As long as he doesn't move, the whole game holds together. He isn't the strongest. He's just never admitted defeat.
djzc.wiki_ltjd_1: Vertical Maneuvering Equipment: the sky that took flight out of a pile of bugs
djzc.wiki_ltjd_2: Designed by Dong. He is Dong's MC Warfare's fourth class, and the only unit that requires 'five kills' to unlock. — This isn't a barrier; it's respect.
djzc.wiki_ltjd_4: CE says that in the future, he'll get an airfield, and the Aviation Edition Triple Tap will get refueled. Because he deserves it. Back in the era when command blocks covered the map, it was he who first made Dong's MC Warfare's players look up and see that the sky is a battlefield too.
djzc.wiki_scj_1: Trident Soldier: never beaten the Melee Soldier, never given up trying
djzc.wiki_scj_2: Designed by the fishing guy. He has a full Netherite set too. He has a shield too. He even has Ender Pearls, which the Melee Soldier doesn't.
djzc.wiki_scj_3: He just can't beat the Melee Soldier — this isn't a bug, it's destiny.
djzc.wiki_scj_4: Dong's MC Warfare has many classes like this: the Ranger can't catch up to the Sniper, the Operator can't reach %1$s, and the Mage class still hasn't been implemented... Not every class can win, but every class deserves a chance on the field.
djzc.wiki_scj_5: Friendly tip: it can break shields
djzc.wiki_yqb_1: Ranger: the most important thing is to be FAST
djzc.wiki_yqb_2: Designed by CE. 'I hope he becomes a bit more useful in the future.' — Of all the lines in Dong's MC Warfare's class chronicles, this is the one that stings my nose the most.
djzc.wiki_yqb_3: You just gave him %1$s, just gave him Rush III, just gave him Sharpness 50, just gave him the same model as the Sniper's %2$s, and he's still not good enough. The Ranger wasn't a design failure — the Ranger just hasn't succeeded yet.
djzc.wiki_yqb_4: He's waiting for the next version, the next test, the next player willing to pick him and discover 'wait, this is actually this much fun'. So is Dong's MC Warfare.

djzc.dialog.elua.title: Dong's MC Warfare Welcome Screen
djzc.dialog.eula_notice.body1: Welcome to Dong's MC Warfare! Go, Special Forces!
djzc.dialog.eula_notice.body2: — From the opening voice line of PUBG Mobile, and dedicated to everyone who steps into 60144.
djzc.dialog.eula_translate: English translation by DeepSeek, welcome point out mistakes and provide suggestions
djzc.dialog.eula_notice.body4: Resist unhealthy games, reject pirated games. Protect yourself and beware of fraud. Moderate gaming benefits the mind; excessive gaming harms the body. Manage your time wisely and enjoy a healthy life.
djzc.dialog.eula_notice.body7: Class selection, teleporting, the Walkie-Talkie, and the Encyclopedia — all in one place.
djzc.dialog.eula_notice.body9: An admin panel for OPs only — toggle Boost and Debug, and even show the health advisory.
djzc.dialog.eula_notice.body10: · Want to learn more? A README is included in the root of both the resource pack and the data pack
djzc.dialog.eula_notice.body11: It contains a detailed class list, mechanic explanations, and some ramblings from the developers.
djzc.dialog.eula_notice.body13: 1. The use of hacks, cheat software, or malicious exploits is strictly prohibited.
djzc.dialog.eula_notice.body14: No matter which server you play Dong's MC Warfare on, we strongly condemn such behavior. Fair play is the bottom line of Dong's MC Warfare.
djzc.dialog.eula_notice.body15: 2. You may create your own resource packs to modify text, sounds, and textures.
djzc.dialog.eula_notice.body16: However, you are responsible for the content of your pack, and it has no relation to %1$s.
djzc.dialog.eula_notice.body17: 3. Recording videos, livestreaming, or including Dong's MC Warfare in your modpack and distributing it is allowed.
djzc.dialog.eula_notice.body18: Dong's MC Warfare uses multiple licenses:
djzc.dialog.eula_notice.body19: (1) Code: GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1 or later (LGPL-2.1-or-later)
djzc.dialog.eula_notice.body20: (2) Text, images, and other art assets in the "CE's MC Warfare" and "Dong's MC Warfare : Red Loong Pack" resource packs:
djzc.dialog.eula_notice.body24: All musical works included in this resource pack (except those already in the public domain) are copyrighted by their original rights holders.
djzc.dialog.eula_notice.body25: They are included solely for player convenience and do not grant any additional rights beyond fair use.
djzc.dialog.eula_notice.body26: If you plan to use them publicly, redistribute them, or use them for commercial purposes, please obtain authorization from the copyright holders yourself.
djzc.dialog.eula_notice.body28: If you paid for it anywhere, you were scammed.
djzc.dialog.eula_notice.body29: 5. For server-specific rules, please follow the regulations of the respective server.
djzc.dialog.eula_notice.body30: We can't govern every server, but we hope every server is as loving as 60144.
